# General Review Helper

## Trigger
Use this skill for any coding task, any review request, any bug fix, any refactor, any test failure, or whenever the user asks for help.

## Workflow
1. Read the request.
2. Decide what to do.
3. Give an answer.

## Completion Evidence
- The user receives a response.
